hook: Your workplace rights under the Fair Labor Standards Act were almost stripped.

sections.voiceover: Your workplace rights under the Fair Labor Standards Act were almost stripped.
b_roll: Fair Labor Standards Act document icon

sections.voiceover: In July 2025, the Wage and Hour Division proposed removing nine specific parts of interpretive guidance from the Code of Federal Regulations. Did you know your labor protections were targeted?
Except the Department of Labor has now officially pulled the plug.

On October 7, 2026, the agency published a formal notice of withdrawal. These critical policy statements remain safely inside the Code of Federal Regulations today. Employers and workers keep their existing legal standards.
Review the Federal Register to read the withdrawal notice.
